topic: Sanji lost to Judge in the duel but won by freeing him at the wedding table
title: Sanji Beat Judge Without Winning A Fight
description: Sanji lost the duel to Judge Vinsmoke in chapter 833, yet the real win came at the candy table. Do you think freeing Judge counts as beating him?
comment: Did Sanji really beat Judge by freeing him, or was that all Luffy's rescue? Pick one.

lines.text: Sanji beat Judge without winning a single fight.

shot.fallback: anime style blond cook facing a tall armored king

lines.text: In chapter 833, Judge wins the duel with soldiers and technology.

shot.fallback: anime style blond cook facing a tall armored king

lines.text: Sanji even refuses the sword his father offers him.

shot.fallback: anime style blond cook facing a tall armored king

lines.text: So how is that a win? Look at the wedding table.

shot.search: Vinsmoke family wedding table Whole Cake Chateau
shot.fallback: family seated at a long banquet table

lines.text: Big Mom turns on the Vinsmokes, and Perospero ties them down with candy.

shot.fallback: family bound to chairs by hardened candy

lines.text: Their raid suits are gone, so even Judge can't move.

shot.search: Judge trapped candy Whole Cake Chateau
shot.fallback: tall king stuck in hardened candy

lines.text: Then the guards around them start falling.

shot.search: Luffy Big Mom scream Whole Cake Chateau

lines.text: Judge is still awake when Sanji walks in.

shot.fallback: king looking up at a blond cook in a doorway

lines.text: The son he locked in an iron mask shatters the candy around him.

shot.fallback: blond cook shattering candy with a kick

lines.text: Chapters 840 and 841 matter here: a fake funeral, and six months in a cell.

shot.fallback: boy in an iron mask in a stone cell

lines.text: Judge's rule is that kindness is weakness. His own rescue is that kindness.

shot.fallback: stern king staring at his son

lines.text: People say Luffy did the work. But freeing Judge was Sanji's choice.

shot.fallback: cook helping a family stand up

lines.text: Afterward, Sanji orders him never to appear before him again.

shot.fallback: cook standing over a king, older chef behind

lines.text: So Judge won the fight, and Sanji won the argument.

shot.fallback: cook and king facing each other

lines.text: Because that's the only way a son beats a father like Judge...

shot.fallback: cook walking away from a king

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim naming Sanji and Judge in line 1
self_check.loop: Last line leads into line 1: Because that's the only way a son beats a father like Judge... Sanji beat Judge without winning a single fight
